{{Quote|Here's what you've been sent to see, Commander."<br />"The new model warbot the Empire threw at your ground troops on Xeron...!|A Rebel trooper and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="marvel47" />}}
'''Xeron''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="marvel47" /> located within the [[Xeron system/Legends|Xeron system]], a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Xeron was the site of a [[Battle of Xeron|battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] circa [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], where the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] attacked Rebel ground troops with a new [[Imperial warbot|warbot]] to devastating effect.<ref name="marvel47" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xeron was first mentioned in [[Star Wars (1977) 47|''Star Wars'' (1977) 47]], written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1981]].<ref name="marvel47" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Xeron [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Xeron itself, in grid square M-14.<ref name="Atlas" />
